def f(g):
    import numpy as np
    a=np.array(g); out=a.copy(); H,W=a.shape
    def runs(idxs):
        out_=[]; cur=[idxs[0]]
        for x in idxs[1:]:
            if x==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(x)
            else: out_.append(cur); cur=[x]
        out_.append(cur); return out_
    def nz(v): return (np.array(v)!=0).any()
    for c in range(W):
        col=[r for r in range(H) if a[r,c]==5]
        if len(col)>=2:
            for rr in runs(col):
                if len(rr)<2 or c+1>=W: continue
                r0,r1=rr[0],rr[-1]
                rows=[r for r in range(H) if a[r,c+1]!=0]
                grp=[r for r in rows if r0<=r<=r1]
                if not (grp and grp[-1]==r1): continue
